title: Detection of heteromerization of more than two proteins by sequential BRET-FRET
protocol: Select the donor, acceptor, and substrate combination for SRET2 or SRET1 experiments.
Generate fusion constructs in Rluc, GFP2, YFP, or DsRed expression vectors with the cDNA of the protein of interest inserted in-frame with the bioluminescent or fluorescent molecule's cDNA.
Validate the fusion proteins by comparing them to wild-type proteins using functional assays.
Check for detectable luminescence or fluorescence from the transfected cDNA.
Use confocal microscopy to visualize correct cellular localization of the fusion protein.
Reconstitute and store the luciferase substrate stock solution with anhydrous ethanol.
Aliquot cells in a 6-well cell culture plate in suitable growth medium.
Maintain cells at 37°C, 5% CO2 until they reach 60-80% confluence after 24 hours.
Transfect expression vectors corresponding to the desired fusion proteins using PEI according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Around 48 hours after transfection, detach the cells and resuspend in HBSS assay buffer.
Wash cells twice with assay buffer for 5 minutes and then resuspend in the same buffer.
Quantify the amount of protein with Bradford solution from an aliquot.
Dilute cells to maintain the same amount of protein in each sample.
Aliquot cells into 96-well white and black isoplates (100 μL per black well and 90 μL per white well).

Use a fluorimeter to measure the relative fluorescence from aliquots of each sample in 100 μL per well, black isoplates by directly exciting the first acceptor fluorophore with laser light at a suitable wavelength (410 nm for GFP2 or 485 nm for YFP) and detecting the emission (510 nm for GFP2 or 530 nm for YFP).
Directly excite the second acceptor fluorophore with laser light at a suitable wavelength (485 nm for YFP or 544 nm for DsRed) and detect the emission (530 nm for YFP or 590 nm for DsRed).
Correct the background fluorescence with untransfected cells.
Add 10 μL of Coelenterazine h to aliquots of each sample in 90 μL per well in white isoplates.
Incubate for 10 minutes.
Measure luminescence at 485 nm in a luminometer.
Correct the background from untransfected cells.
Define YFP fluorescence in SRET2 experiments as the signal detected at 530 nm minus the signal for cells expressing protein-Rluc and protein-GFP2.
Perform linear unmixing taking into account the spectral signature.
Define DsRed fluorescence in SRET1 experiments as the signal detected at 590 nm minus the signal for cells expressing protein-Rluc and protein-YFP.
For protein-Rluc/protein-GFP2/protein-YFP transfection, measure SRET2 by adding 10 μL of DeepBlueC to each 90 μL white well.
Immediately detect emission at 530 nm and 410 nm using a luminometer.
For protein-Rluc/protein-YFP/protein-DsRed transfection, measure SRET1 by adding 10 μL of Coelenterazine h to each 90 μL white well one minute before detection.
Detect emission at 590 nm and 485 nm using a luminometer.
Repeat readings within the timeframe allowed by substrate stability and cell viability.

Quantify SRET: Calculate Net SRET1 as \[\(emission at 590 nm)/\( emission at 485 nm)]-Cf, where Cf is \[\(emission at 590 nm)/\( emission at 485 nm)\] for cells expressing protein-Rluc, protein-GFP and the other protein partner not fused to a fluorescence protein.

Quantify SRET: Calculate Net SRET2 as \[\(emission at 530 nm)/\( emission at 410 nm)]-Cf, where Cf is \[\(emission at 530 nm)/\( emission at 410 nm)\] for cells expressing protein-Rluc, protein-YFP and the other protein partner not fused to a fluorescence protein.
